description: Sanford, FL – Today, Florida Congresswoman Lois Frankel announced her support for Navy combat veteran and former NASA Chief of Staff Bale Dalton, in the race to unseat Rep. Cory Mills in Florida’s Seventh District.
paid_for_by: Paid for by Dalton for Florida Bale Dalton is a former member of the United States Navy and current member of the United States Navy Reserve
title: Florida Congresswoman Lois Frankel Endorses Bale Dalton in Campaign to Unseat Rep. Cory Mills - Bale Dalton
